scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
One shot.
One kill.
It's not so hard
once you develop the
vision for that style
of battling.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
一箭斃命。
只要練就適合這種戰法的眼力，就不難做到。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
The world is in
need of mighty Bowmen
like you. Are you ready for
the awesome responsibility?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
世界需要你這樣強大的弓箭手。
你準備好承擔這份重任了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Are you willing to
take the next step and
become a Sniper?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你願意更進一步，成為神射手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Congratulations!
As a Sniper, I hope
that the minions of evil
will never be safe so
long as they are in
your sight!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜！
願你身為神射手，讓所有進入你視野的邪惡爪牙，都無處可逃！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向勇士們致敬！
